name: Maou no Taoshikata
source:
Once upon a time, there was an unbeatable monster in the devildom.
He was so invulnerable that nothing can hurt him, and being enchanted by magic could not be more serious than being bitten by a mosquito for him.
Over time, both the human and the monster were so afraid of him that he got the title of the Archfiend.
However, being invincible was so lonely. Though he was a world-beater, he had no friends around him, let alone a girlfriend.
Finally, he was provoked by the Brave couple with displays of affection. Then he decided to venture around the world to find his companions and set up the legion of Archfiend.
However the monsters that he met are——
The Slime who loves money only
Durahan who is a reckless girl
The Goddess of lake who is dissipated
And all sorts of Braves who manage to kill him
Can he overcome all difficulties and find companions?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/782180/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
很久以前，魔界出现了一个无敌怪物。
他坚不可摧，任何东西都伤不了他；魔法对他而言，严重程度不超过蚊子叮咬。
随着时间流逝，人类与怪物都对他感到恐惧，他因此获得了“大魔王”的称号。

然而，无敌也十分孤独。虽然他天下无敌，身边却没有朋友，更别说女朋友。
最终，他被勇者情侣秀恩爱刺激到，决定周游世界寻找同伴，建立大魔王军团。

可是，他遇到的怪物竟然是——

只爱金钱的史莱姆；
鲁莽的女孩杜拉汉；
放荡的湖中女神；
以及各种能够杀死他的勇者。

他能克服一切困难，找到同伴吗？

（来源：[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/782180/]Steam[/url]）
